What happened: our auditor issued the Type II for the 2023-06-01 to 2024-05-31 period (doc ID A-2024-001). Some filenames and timestamps were overwritten which caused the mismatch you observed.

I am attaching: 1) redwood_soc2_type2_2024-2025.pdf (newest Type II) and 2) bridge_letter_202607.pdf — a short bridge/clarification letter from BrightAudit that explains the reissue and maps document IDs to audit periods. BrightAudit is also CC'd on this thread in case you want an auditor contact.
